shortdesc.ph: Callback when a remote user enables or disables local video capture.
Callback triggered when a specified remote user enables or disables local video capture.
Occurs when a specific remote user enables/disables the local video capturing function.

section.p: This callback is triggered when the remote user calls to resume or stop video capture.
The SDK triggers this callback when the remote user resumes or stops capturing the video stream by calling the method.

section.title: Trigger Timing
section.p: This callback is triggered when a remote user calls to enable or disable local video capture.

plentry.pd:
Whether the specified remote user enables local video capture:
: Enables the video module. Other users in the channel can see the remote user's video.
: Disables the video module. Other users in the channel cannot receive the remote user's video stream, but the remote user can still receive video streams from others.

Whether the specified remote user enables local video capture:
: Enables the video module. Other users in the channel can see the remote user's video.
: Disables the video module. Other users in the channel cannot receive the remote user's video stream, but the remote user can still receive video streams from others.
The user ID of the remote user.

pd.p:
Whether the specified remote user enables/disables local video capturing:
: The video module is enabled. Other users in the channel can see the video of this remote user.
: The video module is disabled. Other users in the channel can no longer receive the video stream from this remote user, while this remote user can still receive the video streams from other users.
